segments.sn32.54:1.2: Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn32.54:1.3: “ko nu kho, bhante, hetu, ko paccayo, yenekadā uṇhaṃ hotī”ti?
segments.sn32.54:1.6: ‘yaṃnūna mayaṃ sakāya ratiyā vaseyyāmā’ti, tesaṃ taṃ cetopaṇidhimanvāya uṇhaṃ hoti.
segments.sn32.54:1.7: Ayaṃ kho, bhikkhu, hetu, ayaṃ paccayo, yenekadā uṇhaṃ hotī”ti.
